title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine
description: BDR v1.1.0 extends the stable v1 line with an additive atomic logical-write path for Memoria.ia integration. It preserves the existing bdr::Database source contract and BDR3/BDW3 readers while adding bdr::AtomicDatabase, atomic write_batch/put_many/erase_many operations, explicit durability modes, and the versioned BDW4 write-ahead log with all-or-nothing crash recovery. Performance claims remain workload-specific and the project does not claim strict worst-case O(1) complexity for the complete engine. The associated scientific preprint is a separate Zenodo publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21937842.
